notes.title: The Wolf's Bite 1.1.0 is now live!
notes.notes: No content updates, but it fixes a few pesky bugs preventing a few of the harder to reach endings from being reached, and also cleans up a couple of typos. Thanks for playing, and thanks for alerting me to the issues! :)

notes.title: The Wolf's Bite v1.0.8 Released!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We just released patch 1.0.8. This update includes the fixes of a few more typos that snuck by us during editing. Additionally, this patch includes a small change that makes all stat buffs appear in either red or green text, for easier recognition while reading.

Cheers,
The Wolf's Bite Team

notes.title: The Wolf's Bite v1.0.7 Released!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We've quietly released several small patches since release. These patches include numerous bug fixes, and many small text edits and grammar fixes to the game's story text. We hope you continue to enjoy playing The Wolf's Bite!

Cheers,
The Wolf's Bite Team
